# Arlington heights

## Doctors of Physical Therapy

### Welcome to DPT - Arlington Heights!

At our Arlington Heights physical therapy clinic, we provide compassionate, evidence-based care. Every patient receives individualized treatment from an expert clinician. Whether you’re recovering from injury or surgery or simply addressing a longtime ache or pain that keeps you from optimal function, we’re here to help you get better, faster!

We are conveniently located on Campbell and fully staffed with a team that is ready to take on all of your needs. In addition to great orthopedic care, we specialize in overhead athletes.

You can call or click today to schedule your FREE consult and your first visit with our expert physical therapist in Arlington Heights, IL.

We can’t wait to see you!

### Find us Here

1611 W. Campbell St.

Arlington Heights, IL 60005

### Get In touch

Phone: 847-798-6318

Fax: 847-787-9558

### Clinic Hours

Mon: 8am- 7pm

Tues: 8am- 7pm

Wed: 8am- 7pm

Thurs: 8am- 7pm

Fri: 8am- 5pm

Saturday: Closed

Sunday: Closed
